subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streams treat the configured guarded-fetch timeout as an idle/no-progress timeout while chunks arrive?
rationale: The code evidence supports parity with sibling streaming transports, but changing timeout semantics for an existing provider is compatibility-sensitive and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Require proof, then accept idle-timeout parity
options.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama behavior proof, then merge this narrow provider-owned fix if the run completes.

options.title: Keep wall-clock timeout semantics
options.body: Reject or revise the PR if maintainers want `timeoutSeconds` to remain a hard cap for native Ollama streams even while chunks arrive.

options.title: Defer to a broader Ollama runtime fix
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want to solve the linked stall through a larger stream/runtime refactor instead of this targeted callback refresh.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept idle-timeout parity
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama behavior proof, then merge this narrow provider-owned fix if the run completes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama stream maintenance makes this the best available routing owner for the provider behavior choice.
